name: MOW_ASGN_RULE_CONDITIONS
description: Table to store the assignment rule conditions

columns.name: RULE_CONDITION_ID
columns.description: Primary Key to uniquely identify the row

columns.name: RULE_CONDITION_NUMBER
columns.description: PUID to uniquely identify the condition row. Foreign Key to the MOW_RULE_CONDITIONS entity.

columns.name: RULE_CONDITION_VALUE_NUMBER
columns.description: PUID to uniquely identify the row.

columns.name: RULE_GUID
columns.description: Foreign Key to the MOW_RULES table.

columns.name: RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of Rules Entity. Foreign Key to the MOW_RULES table

columns.name: LHS_OBJECT
columns.description: The assignment object code. Foreign Key to the MOW_ASGN_OBJECTS_B table

columns.name: LHS_OBJECT_ATTR
columns.description: Contains LHS assignment object attribute

columns.name: OPERATOR
columns.description: The operator that is been used for a Rule condition.

columns.name: VALUE
columns.description: The RHS value of the rule condition

columns.name: RHS_OBJECT
columns.description: The assignment object code in RHS of condition. Foreign Key to the MOW_ASGN_OBJECTS_B table

columns.name: RHS_OBJECT_ATTR
columns.description: Contains RHS assignment object attribute

columns.name: LHS_OBJECT_FK_ID_ATTR
columns.description: Stores the Id attribute if LHS Object Attr is a Join attr or DCL attr

columns.name: RECORD_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates if Rule Condition has been published to Engine

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.
